div.head: Ordal 5.2
div.ab: 7 inseglige man þa hand, ⁊ sé[c]e man ófer þæne þriddan dǽg, swa hwæðer swa heo béo ful swa clæne binnan þam in-segle.
Et (post) insigilletur manus (eius) et inquiratur die tertia, si inmunda sit uel munda in ipsa sigillacione (intra sigillationem).
And ga he tó and in-seglige man þa hand, and séce man ófer þæne þriddan dǽg, swa hwæðer swa heo béo ful swa clæne binnan þam in-segle.
Und die Hand werde versiegelt, und nach dem dritten Tage werde untersucht, ob sie innerhalb des Verschlusszeichens schuldbefleckt oder rein sei.
And let the hand be sealed, and after the third day let it be examined whether it is foul or clean within the seal.

And the accused shall go to the ordeal, and his hand shall be sealed up; and after three days it shall be inspected [in order] to ascertain whether it has become discoloured or remained clean within the sealed wrappings.
div.note: H reads ‘séte’; Liebermann prints ‘sé[c]e’ as the Quadripartitus read and Price corrected. The last ‘ge’ of ‘inseglige’ is on an erasure. Liebermann compares II As 23.1.
